title: Report of `cli.mjs aggregate`: per-session block stats, pooled per-variant stats and the identity comparison

identity.description: within-variant:<v>:<facet> (every facet equal within a variant) and across-variants:<facet> (equal unless declared). Facets: corpus, adapter, config, toolchain, build, browser, harness, observer, host, profile, schedule.

items.description: measured: planned, attempted, success, stale, timeout, error, notAttempted and latencyMs { n, min, median, p95NearestRank, max, values, conditionalOnSuccess, failuresPresent }. warmup: the same counts, excludedFromStats.

pooled.description: variant -> { sessions, ops: { <scenario>/<opId>: { measured } } } with counts summed and latencies concatenated across the variant's sessions.
